name: MixRT
aliases: Mixed Neural Representations For Real-Time NeRF Rendering
definition: A NeRF representation consisting of three components: (1) a low-quality mesh providing coarse geometry, (2) a view-dependent displacement map to calibrate ray-mesh intersection points, and (3) a compressed NeRF model in Instant-NGP format providing density and color.
summary: MixRT enables real-time NeRF rendering on edge devices by decomposing scenes into a mesh, displacement map, and compressed NeRF, leveraging distinct hardware units to bypass ray-marching bottlenecks.
